description: The async shell tool reported completion of nohup child launch/wait commands while their scoring children remained alive as PPID 1. A second phase launch and a diagnostic relaunch ran the same frozen shards concurrently. Once the process table established this, eight duplicate workers were terminated and the original four were retained. No arm, lambda, checkpoint, label, contrast, or frozen rule changed and no outcome-dependent model selection was performed.
original_and_duplicate_launch_handle: bg_38 (pass1 and pass2 launch commands returned before nohup children exited)
diagnostic_launch_handle: unregistered foreground shell relaunch; observed children listed above
original_launch_time_estimate_utc: 2026-10-14T12:19Z +/- 1 minute, inferred from first retained scoring ledger wall times and worker elapsed times
first_duplicate_launch_time_estimate_utc: 2026-10-14T12:19Z +/- 1 minute (same elapsed time as the original batch)
diagnostic_duplicate_launch_time_estimat: 2026-10-14T12:33Z +/- 1 minute, inferred from process-table elapsed time difference
duplicate_cancellation_time_estimate_utc: 2026-10-14T12:40Z +/- 2 minutes; successful kill -TERM, exact UTC cancellation timestamp was not captured
overwrites_evidence: Repeated completion lines confirm at least F-1-continuous--seed20260908.json and F-1-micro--seed20260909.json were written twice. Other completed shard-prefix records may also have been overwritten. Shared output paths and nonexclusive writes did not preserve every pre-overwrite timing/header. Deterministic endpoints are checked against #101, but discarded metadata cannot be reconstructed exactly.
compute_status: ESTIMATE: conservative allocated-process accounting bound, not a measurement of CUDA active seconds
compute_bound_definition: 8 duplicate workers: four observed at 1263 s and four at 407 s, plus one minute each allowance between observation and termination (7160 s); discarded diagnostic foreground scoring 240+120+42 s; first superseded smoke 45.86 s; smoke label probe 73.42 s; remainder rounds conservatively to 8200 s. These allocated-process wall seconds are conservatively charged as GPU seconds, not CUDA active time.
claim_qualification: Literal scored-once execution did not hold for the duplicated fixed-arm prefixes. Retained deterministic records are reproducibility-checked; inferential findings must disclose this operational deviation. Measured timing under accidental contention cannot be treated as an isolated-device latency benchmark.
